data.summary: Wells Fargo has taken a strategic step toward AI integration by appointing Saul Van Beurden as Head of Artificial Intelligence in November 2025, a rare executive structure at the board level indicating AI as a core growth driver. While the 10-K does not detail extensive AI product deployment, this appointment signals management's commitment to embedding AI across operations and customer experience.
evidence: Saul Van Beurden appointed as Senior Executive Vice President, Co-CEO of Consumer Banking and Lending, and Head of Artificial Intelligence effective November 2025
data.source: Form 10-K, Item 10: Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance
